subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` become a supported public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/session-store-runtime` contract for destructive channel lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but adding a public Plugin SDK API is a permanent compatibility decision that automation cannot make solely from patch quality.

options.title: Approve and document the helper
options.body: Keep the generic canonical reset API, document its lifecycle guarantees, resolve the branch conflict, and merge after exact-head validation.

options.title: Keep lifecycle reset internal
options.body: Replace the public export with a narrow injected runtime capability while retaining the same canonical accessor and admission-fence behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the helper
recommendation.body: Keep the generic canonical reset API, document its lifecycle guarantees, resolve the branch conflict, and merge after exact-head validation.
